mapper.select: SELECT * FROM zentide_briefing WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND briefing_date=#{briefingDate} AND briefing_type='DAILY' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zentide_briefing(owner_id,briefing_date,briefing_type,headline,body_json,item_count,status) VALUES(#{ownerId},#{briefingDate},'DAILY',#{headline},#{bodyJson},#{itemCount},'PUBLISHED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE headline=VALUES(headline),body_json=VALUES(body_json),item_count=VALUES(item_count),status='PUBLISHED'
